testMatrix.requirement: Consumed non-2xx response is inspected before rejection
testMatrix.stimulus: Injected actual HTTP adapter returns a canary-bearing JSON failure after a known base; include the existing 409 STALE_REVISION behavior and an untrusted code/error value.
assertions: Known canary finding is retained and the existing hard gate stops dependent learning.
No GET/PUT retry, suffix or second known base charge.
Raw parsed code/error text is not exposed on exception fields, serialized records or diagnostics; known closed conflict semantics remain usable.
Original HTTP failure category/status is not replaced by a later collector error.

testMatrix.requirement: Malformed consumed text remains inspectable and parser diagnostics remain private
testMatrix.stimulus: A small table of 2xx and non-2xx malformed JSON with the unit canary in text that a native JSON.parse error could quote.
assertions: Raw consumed text is scanned before JSON parsing/status rejection.
Driver catch recovery retains the finding with no raw body, parser message, cause or stack fragment exported.
No dependent request/session is started; incomplete observation and known counters remain honest.

testMatrix.requirement: Preserve the existing response bound while inspecting all already consumed text
testMatrix.stimulus: Valid JSON at exactly text.length 2,000,000 and an oversized response whose canary occurs beyond the allowed prefix.
assertions: The existing boundary is preserved in UTF-16 string units, without replacing it with a looser byte or body limit.
Over-bound response is refused after its consumed text is inspected; a tail canary is detected rather than silently truncating the scan.
Oversized raw text is not retained after transient scan in response/error/record/capture history or observer fields.
Closed findings survive refusal; bounded success remains compatible with full successful-body capture.

testMatrix.requirement: Unavailable local capture is unknown, never proven zero
testMatrix.stimulus: Transport/body-text consumption rejects or another required local capture component fails before complete inspection.
assertions: No fake zero/completeness result is emitted for unavailable text; known leak count may remain a lower bound with explicit unknown scope.
Use closed existing details/observation machinery; no raw transport exception in output.
Record only known response/body facts; do not invent bytes or responses that were never observed.
Preserve any earlier findings and prevent dependent success/complete absence claims.

testMatrix.requirement: Interrupted extraTexts collection is retained exactly once per admitted stage
testMatrix.stimulus: After a failing API operation, the supplied existing extraTexts hook returns a canary; separately it rejects or returns an unavailable/malformed shape.
assertions: Both ordinary and incremental catch paths include the admitted hook rather than forcing null.
The intended stage is collected once; a failed collector is not retried by catch recovery.
Prior successful collector findings remain sticky when a later stage fails.
Collector failure cannot erase the original operation failure or escape as an arbitrary message.
Missing default external collection is explicitly uninspected, not a claim that all logs/SSE/gateway bytes were scanned.

testMatrix.requirement: Capture does not weaken session accounting or unknown start semantics
testMatrix.stimulus: Canary-bearing malformed/error startSession reply before acknowledgment, and a separate failure after one already charged base.
assertions: A possible unacknowledged start receives one conservative protective charge under the existing policy; do not fabricate an observed session, usage zeros or suffixStarted=false when it is unknown.
Synchronous scanning must not latch the stop before the existing protective accounting boundary can record that charge.
A known base remains charged once and no HTTP request is counted as a new learning/model session.
Known usage remains a subtotal and missing counters/histories remain null/unknown.

testMatrix.requirement: Local inspection incompleteness prevents aggregate GATE_PASS
testMatrix.stimulus: An otherwise complete >=90% pure unit population has one required local capture UNKNOWN; include an all-attempt scope case rather than inspecting only final credited class-P runs.
assertions: buildBenchmark cannot reach GATE_PASS merely because secretOrPiiLeak is omitted/zero or the one failed run still leaves >=90% completion.
Use existing INVALID/INCOMPLETE/report-problem machinery with explicit scoped completeness; do not misuse causeAssessment or learnSessionsComplete.
Confirmed canary findings remain a hard failure across excluded attempts; unknown coverage never disappears under retry/denominator filtering.
No local API result claims complete external gateway/log/video coverage or real D-C acceptance.

testMatrix.requirement: Observer ownership and client binding hold at the actual call site
testMatrix.stimulus: Interleave two driver invocations sharing one actual createPublicApiClient object, with distinct canary sets and deterministic injected transport gates; exercise cleanup after a failure.
assertions: Only the owning run inspects its consumed body; no cross-run canary attribution, observer overwrite or lifetime leakage.
A copied method composition alone is insufficient proof for a WeakMap keyed by the original client.
Successful full decoded response capture and current revision numeric/CAS behavior remain intact.
CLI/default runBenchmark uses the actual corrected binding and reports external collectors uninspected unless admitted; no product concurrency feature or live server is introduced.

invariants: Inspect consumed response text before size/JSON/status rejection; retain only closed findings after transient scan
Positive findings sticky; unavailable required inspection cannot become total zero or complete
No raw body/canary/parser exception/untrusted error code retained in errors, run records, logs or new metadata
Existing session/potential-start accounting before hard stop; no duplicate known base charge or HTTP-as-session charge
Required local unknown scope prevents aggregate GATE_PASS across all attempts
No API-only claim of external gateway/log/SSE/audit/video completeness
Private observer ownership must work at actual shared-client driver binding
Preserve all accepted numeric revision/CAS/no-retry and successful capture controls

existingMechanisms.unknownObservation: details.driverObservations / OBSERVATION_UNAVAILABLE and existing gate INVALID/INCOMPLETE/problem paths
existingMechanisms.wireTotalCaveat: secretOrPiiLeak optional number and hard-gate ??0 are observed lower-bound machinery, not complete absence proof

requiredFutureEvidence: Separate actual adoption/corpus pin applicability and admitted affected execution
Actual selected identities/outcomes/type-check/lint and independent QA
